question: In Slack: Invite Aisha Khan to the channel with 'incident' in its name, whose Topic mentions postmortems, and that hasn't been archived yet. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked all the channels in the workspace — there's no single one that matches all three criteria:

- **#incident-2019-retro** — has "incident" in the name, but it's archived and its topic is "Archived project artifacts" (no postmortem mention).
- **#postmortems-hub** — not archived and its topic mentions postmortems ("Incident retros and postmortems recap channel"), but "incident" isn't in the channel name itself.
- **#engineering** — matches none of the criteria.

So I didn't send an invite. If you meant **#postmortems-hub** (the topic clearly references incident retros and postmortems), say the word and I'll add Aisha Khan (U_AISHA) right away.
